css: injected by the host (do not import)
import: import { Button, DataGrid, DatePicker, useApp, Icon } from "@mohou/ui"

families.name: Layout & structure
families.blurb: Shell / split / scroll containers and display atoms — they arrange, they don't interact.

families.name: Navigation
families.blurb: Menus, sidebars, palettes, tabs, pagination, scroll-spy.

families.name: Surface
families.blurb: Elevates content above the page: card, dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, tooltip, accordion.

families.name: Form
families.blurb: Inputs, selects, toggles, buttons and actions — anything the user edits.

families.name: Data & tables
families.blurb: Rows, grids, boards, trees, sortable lists and their filters.

families.name: Chart & data
families.blurb: Stat / KPI cards, charts, gauges, sparklines, git graph.

families.name: Feedback & status
families.blurb: Status/severity badges, progress, skeleton, spinner, alerts, empty states, toasts.

families.name: Calendar & date
families.blurb: Calendars, date/time pickers and ranges, durations, timezones, scheduling views.

families.name: Realtime
families.blurb: Live feeds, timelines, logs and consoles.

families.name: Rich text
families.blurb: Markdown / rich-text render and edit, wiki markup.

families.name: Discovery & inspect
families.blurb: Inspect, compare and browse artefacts: diff, JSON, code, requests, attachments.

families.name: Animation
families.blurb: Entrance / exit / layout motion: reveal, stagger, animated presence.

ActivityFeed.when: Read-only “who did what when” — commits, deploys, agent runs. For steps with status use `RunTimeline`.

Alert.when: Explaining a failed state in place. Transient → `toast()`.

AlertDialog.when: Deleting/irreversible actions that must be answered.

AppShell.when: Root layout for a mini-app page

AspectRatio.when: Keeping an image/video/embed from shifting the layout while loading.

Attachment.when: One selected file inside a form. A grid of many → `AttachmentGallery`.

AttachmentGallery.when: A record has N files/images and you show them as tiles, not a table.

Autocomplete.when: Free text allowed but known values should be suggested. Strict pick-list → `Select`.

Avatar.when: User initials/photo next to a name in rows, comments, pickers.

Breadcrumb.when: Deep mini-app views; usually one level is enough — prefer `Tabs`/`AppShell` nav.

Button.when: Every click target. `variant="destructive"` for delete, `size="icon*"` for icon-only (add aria-label).

ButtonGroup.when: 2–5 mutually related actions (view switch, alignment). Tabs of content → `Tabs`.

Calendar.when: An inline calendar inside your own layout. As a field with input → `DatePicker`.

Card.when: The default container for a block of related UI.

Cascader.when: Hierarchical codes (region → site → line). Flat tree → `TreeView`.

Chart.when: Only when no `*Chart` block fits — then you own the series. Prefer `DonutChart` / `StackedBarChart` / `Sparkline` / `Gauge` / `RadarChart`.

CodeEditor.when: Editing config/scripts in-app. Do not `import @codemirror/*` or add it to package.json. Soft wrap uses CodeMirror `EditorView.lineWrapping` when `lineWrapping` is true.

Collapsible.when: A single disclosure (advanced options). Several stacked → `Accordion`.

ColorPicker.when: Theme/label colour config. Never for secrets.

Combobox.when: When you need full control of the popover list. Simple suggestion box → `Autocomplete`.

Command.when: Jump between views/actions inside one app.

CommentThread.when: Issue/ticket discussion, review comments. Editing a comment is your job, not the component's.

CommitGraph.when: App history, release notes, git timeline views

ConfirmDialog.when: Any destructive action. Needs a form inside → compose `Dialog` yourself.

Copyable.when: IDs, hashes, URLs, tokens the user pastes elsewhere.

CurrencyInput.when: Money fields; keeps the raw string out of your state.

DashboardShell.when: Page shape: metrics up top, charts below, optional activity rail — ops overviews, monitor walls

DataGrid.when: Any list/table of rows — prefer over raw Table*

DatePicker.when: Filtering or storing one day. With a clock → `DateTimePicker`.

DescriptionList.when: Detail/inspector panel of a selected row — the default “show one record” view.

Dialog.when: Focused edit/confirm flow. Needs no focus takeover → `Sheet`. Destructive yes/no → `ConfirmDialog`. Size it with `width` on `DialogContent`: the base caps at `sm:max-w-sm`, so a `max-w-*` in `className` loses at ≥sm.

DiffViewer.when: Comparing two versions of text. Pass `original` + `modified` strings.

DonutChart.when: Part-of-whole (≤6 slices): storage usage, status split. More categories → `StackedBarChart`.

Drawer.when: Mobile-ish bottom sheet on narrow panels. Desktop detail → `Sheet`.

DurationInput.when: Timeouts/estimates where you store minutes but type human units.

Empty.when: Any list/panel with no rows — pair media with an `Illu*`.

EnvBadge.when: prd / stg / dev markers in headers and tables.

Field.when: Any form row that must read well and stay accessible.

FileDropzone.when: Getting a local File into the app (then upload via `ctx.http` in the api layer).

FileTree.when: Repo/zip contents where selection matters. Plain nested list → `TreeView`.

FilterBar.when: Above DataGrid or any filtered list

FormSheet.when: Page shape: focused create/edit over a list — new record, edit record, wizard-less config

Gantt.when: Plans/schedules with start+end per row. Ordered events → `Timeline`.

Gauge.when: A single health/capacity number that needs a zone (SLO, disk). Series over time → `Sparkline`.

HoverCard.when: Peek a user/issue without navigating. Needs a decision → `Dialog`.

InputGroup.when: Search/url/amount fields with adornments; keep validation in `NumberField` etc.

Item.when: A uniform list row when `DataGrid` is too heavy.

JqlInput.when: Issue search / saved filters. Needs a real field list: pass `fields`.

JsonViewer.when: API responses/config. Plain text with wrapping → `CodeBlock`.

KanbanIssuePanel.when: Board + click-to-edit issue. Pair with `Kanban`'s selected card.

Label.when: Always bind `htmlFor` — bare text labels are not accessible.

ListDetail.when: Page shape: click a row, then read or edit that one record beside the list — orders, tickets, contacts, log lines

LiveRefresh.when: Dashboards / workbenches that need periodic soft refresh inside the iframe.

Markdown.when: Model output, README-ish bodies. Children must be a string.

Marker.when: Small state markers inside a sentence or legend.

Menubar.when: Rarely right for a panel-width mini-app — prefer `Tabs` / `DropdownMenu`.

MessageScroller.when: Streaming chat output. Logs by timestamp → `LogViewer`.

MiniCalendar.when: Inside a popover or sidebar. Full page with events → `EventCalendar`.

NativeSelect.when: Short option lists where a plain select is enough and `Select` is overkill.

NavigationMenu.when: Not for mini-apps with one screen — use `Tabs` or `AppShell` sidebar.

NotificationCenter.when: Inbox/alert panel. Audit log (read-only, with time) → `ActivityFeed`.

NumberField.when: Any number the user edits — keeps NaN out of your state.

PageHeader.when: Top of a page inside AppShell main

Pagination.when: Only when you page by hand; `DataGrid` does this itself.

PasswordField.when: Typing a token/password into your own state. **Never** persist it to storage.

Popover.when: Small editor/filter anchored to a control. Menus of commands → `DropdownMenu`.

ProgressRing.when: One percent-done value in a tight space (card corner, table cell).

Questionnaire.when: Structured ask-the-user blocks; you persist the answers.

RadarChart.when: Comparing an item across 4–8 dimensions (scores, coverage).

RelativeDatePicker.when: Dashboard filters where “last 7 days” beats two calendars.

RequestInspector.when: Debugging one API call: method, url, bodies. Multiple calls streaming → `LogViewer`.

Resizable.when: Master-detail or editor + preview inside the app body.

Reveal.when: A card, row, or section appearing on first paint or after a filter change. Not for a hover/press response (one property: use a Tailwind `transition`) and not for animating an element out (use `AnimatePresence`).

RichTextEditor.when: Notes/descriptions you store as **HTML**. Markdown → `MarkdownEditor`; code → `CodeEditor`. Sanitize server-side before rendering elsewhere.

RunTimeline.when: CI/agent/job phases on a time axis. Plain ordered events → `Timeline`.

ScrollArea.when: A bounded panel (list in a card). Whole-page scroll → plain div.

Scrollspy.when: Long settings/report page with jump links.

SearchInput.when: Filter-as-you-type against `DataGrid`/lists — use `onDebouncedChange` for network calls.

Select.when: Closed set of options (searchable/large → `Autocomplete` or `DataGrid` filter).

SettingsSplit.when: Page shape: a settings page, integration config, or a long report with anchored sections

Sheet.when: Detail/edit panel that keeps the list visible — the usual master-detail pattern. Size it with `width` on `SheetContent`: the panel carries its own `data-[side=right]:sm:max-w-sm` / `data-[side=left]:sm:max-w-sm`, so a `max-w-*` in `className` loses at ≥sm (inline style or `!max-w-*` also work).

Sidebar.when: Many sections in one app; `AppShell` already wires one for you.

Skeleton.when: First paint while `call()` is pending — match the real layout's size.

SortableList.when: Priority queues / column order. Read-only ordered events → `Timeline`.

Sparkline.when: Trend inside a table row or KPI card.

Spinner.when: Inside a button while `call()` is pending. Known % → `Progress`.

StackedBarChart.when: Comparing several series across categories (pass/fail per day). Single ratio → `DonutChart`; trend → `Sparkline`.

StatusBadge.when: pass | fail | blocked | flaky | running | pending cells and chips

Stepper.when: Wizard/progress of an ordered process. Time axis → `RunTimeline`.

StepperItem.when: As a child of `Stepper` only — status is `default | active | completed` (lowercase).

Table.when: Only when you need full control of cells. Otherwise use `DataGrid` (sorting/filter/paging/CSV built in).

TablePage.when: Page shape: one wide filterable table is the product — inventories, ledgers, saved views

Tabs.when: Board vs table, or settings sections. Navigation between routes/pages → keep it in your own state.

TagInput.when: Labels/owners where free values are allowed (`Transfer` when choosing from a fixed pool).

Terminal.when: Showing a command + its output verbatim. Timestamped levels/scrolling → `LogViewer`.

TestStepList.when: QA cases, checklists that get executed and graded.

TimePicker.when: Clock-only fields. `value` is a string, not a Date.

TimeWheel.when: Inside a time picker where tapping a list beats typing. Prefer `TimePicker` for a normal field.

TimezoneSelect.when: Pair with `DateTimePicker` when data is UTC.

Toast.when: Confirm/save feedback. Put `<Toaster position="bottom-right" timeout={4000} limit={3} />` in the root, then `toast.add(...)`.

ToggleGroup.when: Multiple independent on/off buttons; exclusive selection → `Tabs`/`ButtonGroup`.

Tooltip.when: Explaining an icon-only button. Never put an action in it.

Transfer.when: Selecting many items from a known pool (assign users to a shift).

TreeView.when: Any hierarchy without file semantics. Files → `FileTree`.

TrendCard.when: Metric + direction over time. Metric only → `StatCard`.

UserPicker.when: Assignee/owner fields; you supply the user list.

WizardShell.when: Page shape: create / import / onboarding, one step at a time with validation per step
